description: 365Score Patches v1.0.0: Unlock premium, disable ads, block update screen, and disable analytics.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks 365Score premium features (ad-free, tipster, plus, notification sounds) without a subscription.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Removes banner and interstitial advertisements from 365Score activities.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Removes analytics and tracking SDK initialization and logging (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics) from 365Score.

patches.name: Block update screen
patches.description: Blocks the 'This app is out of date' update screen and popup on launch.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Changes the version code of 365Score to prevent forced updates and Play Store overwrites.

options.description: The version code to spoof. Default is 999999.
